opportunities.candidate_theorem: For every faithful sigma on M2, every primitive KMS-symmetric Heisenberg QMS with positive generator L and every faithful state rho, J(rho) >= 2 E(rho), with Schrödinger dual channel CPTP and sigma-preserving.
opportunities.equivalent_named_endpoint: Kastoryano-Temme weak L_p regularity at p=1 under their normalization E_1(f) >= E_2(I_{2,1}f).
opportunities.strongest_matching_prior: Kastoryano-Temme Conjecture 19 conjectures weak L_p regularity for every primitive finite-dimensional Liouvillian, including this endpoint. Established stronger regularity is available for GNS, tracial/unital, and bounded thermal/Davies subclasses.
opportunities.decisive_scope_gap: No checked primary theorem establishes weak p=1 for arbitrary non-GNS KMS qubit generators. GNS quantum Stroock-Varopoulos and strong-Lp theorems require additional GNS/modular covariance hypotheses; MLSI theorems do not imply the pointwise J/E comparison.

compatibility.heisenberg: P_t=e^{-tL} is unital CP, sigma-invariant, and KMS self-adjoint.
compatibility.schrodinger: Phi_t=P_{t*} is CPTP and sigma-preserving; Phi_t^*=P_t is unital. Do not assume Schrödinger unitality unless sigma=I/d.
compatibility.channel_transfer: A KMS-symmetric Heisenberg channel P Poissonizes as exp(t(P-I)), with generator L=I-P. A nonprimitive channel can be regularized by P_epsilon=(1-epsilon)P+epsilon E_sigma and then treated by continuity if the primitive theorem is proved.

opportunities.known_non_gns_qubit_probe: Liu-Wan-Wu Proposition 5.1 supplies a primitive KMS but non-GNS M2 QMS. The separately audited strong-endpoint state has J/E approximately 3.8078, so it violates J>=4E but not J>=2E.
opportunities.decisive_missing_lemma: Prove J(rho)>=2E(rho) for all faithful rho and all faithful sigma for arbitrary primitive KMS-symmetric qubit generators, including non-GNS examples; or exhibit an exact state/generator with J<2E.
opportunities.scope_limit: This qubit theorem would resolve only the d=2 restriction of KT's broader weak-regularity conjecture. No novelty or priority conclusion follows from the bounded literature search.
